title: Booking.com with Jetsetter & Room 77 CEO Drew Patterson

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Acquired trains its lens on the “second or third best acquisition of all-time”, Priceline’s 2005 purchase of Booking.com.
reader_summary.overview: Acquired trains its lens on the “second or third best acquisition of all-time”, Priceline’s 2005 purchase of Booking.com. Our heroes are joined by friend-of-the-show and former Jetsetter & Room 77 CEO Drew Patterson to help understand how this little-known startup from The Netherlands grew into the largest travel company in the world. Was this deal even better than Instagram???
